mapper.sql: select billing_id, request_id, user_id, key_id, subscription_id, subscription_plan_title, billing_source, billing_preference, amount, reserved_amount, wallet_reserved_amount, subscription_reserved_amount, key_reserved_amount, wallet_charged_amount, subscription_charged_amount, key_charged_amount, uncovered_amount, reserve_expire_time, status, log_id, error_message, resolution_reason, resolved_by, resolved_time, create_time, update_time from ai_billing_record
mapper.select: select b.billing_id from ai_billing_record b where b.status = 'reserved' and b.reserve_expire_time <= sysdate() and not exists ( select 1 from ai_billing_settlement_task t where t.billing_id = b.billing_id ) order by b.reserve_expire_time asc, b.billing_id asc limit #{limit}

select b.billing_id from ai_billing_record b where b.status = 'pending_settlement' and not exists ( select 1 from ai_billing_settlement_task t where t.billing_id = b.billing_id ) order by b.billing_id asc limit #{limit}

select b.billing_id from ai_billing_record b where b.status = 'reserved' and b.create_time < #{beforeTime} and not exists ( select 1 from ai_billing_settlement_task t where t.billing_id = b.billing_id ) and exists ( select 1 from ai_log l where l.request_id = b.request_id ) order by b.billing_id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into ai_billing_record (request_id, user_id, key_id, amount, reserved_amount, wallet_reserved_amount, subscription_reserved_amount, key_reserved_amount, wallet_charged_amount, subscription_charged_amount, key_charged_amount, uncovered_amount, status, create_time) values (#{requestId}, #{userId}, #{keyId}, #{amount}, #{reservedAmount}, #{walletReservedAmount}, #{subscriptionReservedAmount}, #{keyReservedAmount}, #{walletChargedAmount}, #{subscriptionChargedAmount}, #{keyChargedAmount}, #{uncoveredAmount}, #{status}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update ai_billing_record set subscription_id = #{subscriptionId}, subscription_plan_title = #{subscriptionPlanTitle}, billing_preference = #{billingPreference}, reserved_amount = #{reservedAmount}, wallet_reserved_amount = #{walletReservedAmount}, subscription_reserved_amount = #{subscriptionReservedAmount}, key_reserved_amount = #{keyReservedAmount}, reserve_expire_time = #{reserveExpireTime}, status = 'reserved', error_message = null, update_time = sysdate() where request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'processing'
update ai_billing_record set amount = #{amount}, status = 'pending_settlement', error_message = null, update_time = sysdate(3) where request_id = #{requestId} and status = 'reserved'

update ai_billing_record set billing_source = #{billingSource}, wallet_charged_amount = #{walletChargedAmount}, subscription_charged_amount = #{subscriptionChargedAmount}, key_charged_amount = #{keyChargedAmount}, uncovered_amount = #{uncoveredAmount}, status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = sysdate(3) where billing_id = #{billingId} and status = 'pending_settlement'
update ai_billing_record set status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, update_time = sysdate() where billing_id = #{billingId} and status = 'reserved'

update ai_billing_record set billing_source = 'write_off', uncovered_amount = amount, status = 'written_off', resolution_reason = #{resolutionReason}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_time = sysdate(3), update_time = sysdate(3) where billing_id = #{billingId} and status in ('reserved', 'pending_settlement') and wallet_charged_amount = 0 and subscription_charged_amount = 0 and key_charged_amount = 0
update ai_billing_record set log_id = #{logId}, update_time = sysdate() where request_id = #{requestId} and log_id is null
mapper.select: select ifnull(sum(ifnull(wallet_charged_amount, 0) + ifnull(subscription_charged_amount, 0)), 0) as totalChargedAmount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(uncovered_amount, 0)), 0) as totalUncoveredAmount from ai_billing_record where user_id = #{userId} and status in ('success', 'partial')

select u.user_id as userId, u.active_request_count as counterCount, ifnull(r.recordCount, 0) as recordCount from sys_user u left join ( select user_id, count(*) as recordCount from ai_billing_record where status = 'reserved' group by user_id ) r on r.user_id = u.user_id where u.active_request_count <> ifnull(r.recordCount, 0)
